text:
The independent JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 map identifies **98% of the 2021 loss area as forest in 2020**, corroborating the pre-loss forest cover. A later year was also observed in the Hansen annual series, satisfying the method’s corroboration rule.

Uruguay’s MGAP 2021 forest map provides additional context: it classifies 68.1 ha of the 81.3 ha loss area as planted forest, with 13.2 ha outside mapped forest and none as native forest.

The JRC map corroborates the forest baseline, not the cause of the loss. The evidence does not establish whether the change was harvest, deforestation or another cause.
